preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string must not be empty.
All characters in the input string must be lowercase.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only lowercase alphabetic characters.
The output string must have the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: any(c in 'aeiou' for c in stdout) or not any(c in 'aeiou' for c in s)
postconditions.description: If the input contains vowels, the output must contain vowels unless the input had no vowels.
